description:
Visually, Zeph can be distinguished as the Section 31 agent covered in cybernetic implants from head to toe, with these augmentations granting him immense physical power. He was a part of the Alpha Team, helping Alok Sahar complete Control's assignment to contact Philippa Georgiou and stop San from passing the Godsend to the Terran Empire. 
Zeph hasn't always been this heavily modified - during his life, he has developed a so-called "mecha dysmorphia," urging him to substitute his body parts with enhanced cybernetics, and he began to fully associate his mech-suit with himself, embracing his new body. However, with all the benefits that the modifications granted to Zeph, the cyborg is prone to a new weakness. With his body so deeply augmented with biomechanical technology, Zeph can be fully controlled against his own will if someone manages to hack into his cybernetics, turning this once obedient agent into a potential malefactor's puppet.

captain_maneuver.name: Chain of Command
captain_maneuver.bonus: This Officer does not have a Captain's Maneuver. Equipping this Officer as the captain of a ship provides no benefit.

officer_ability.name: Mech Life
officer_ability.bonus:
On round start against hostiles, Zeph has a {value} chance to apply a random State to the enemy for 3 rounds.

Random States: Morale, Burning, Hull Breach

below_decks_ability.name: The Suit Is Me
below_decks_ability.bonus:
Increases Apex Barrier against Interceptor hostiles by {value} ({value} at rank {value}).

This ability does not trigger when Tal is assigned to the bridge of your ship.

Apex Barrier provides <b>true damage mitigation from all sources after all other bonuses. Every 100 Apex Barrier increases the damage you can take by 1%.

Below-Deck Abilities are only activated when assigned to a below-decks slot on a ship.
